qualification: Targeted disposable VM on the previously accepted installation; overlay generated with the checked-in ISO build commands. No ISO rebuild; laptop untouched.
vm_checks: Fresh factory user validates with native Niri and inherits terminal/close bindings through the system defaults include
configure-desktop succeeds with shared defaults mounted read-only and leaves system defaults unchanged
Real configure-desktop preserves existing main config, bindings, layout, window rules, wallpaper and terminal preferences
Real Dux binding set/reset overrides stock and restores the stock action on reset
All 143 effective bindings from the prior personal profile remain identical, plus seven deliberately disabled stock shortcuts
Adding a binding through the real Dux writer preserves existing actions, options and MRU preferences
Stow links survive Dux writes; generated layout and stock window rules remain regular local files
Native keypress: Super+Q leaves the probe window alive; Super+Tab moves to the next workspace
Native keypress: Alt+grave switches between same-app windows; Super+W closes the focused window
Stock half-width app exception becomes full width under the personal override
Native validation and shortcut definitions survive VM restart
limits: Disabled shortcuts still consume their key combinations; native Niri has no true unbind operation.
Existing installations retain their full-copy config until explicitly switched; no automatic user-config migration.
independent_review: Muse Spark 1.3: no blocking content defects; untracked entrypoint staged before commit. Build-time generation suggestion implemented and requalified with read-only shared defaults. Alt+grave preservation confirmed in native source and VM.
